title: Squarespace API keys
snippet:
> The Squarespace API has the following availability. To learn more, visit [Choosing the right Squarespace plan](/hc/articles/206536797):
>
> - **Forms API (for Zapier integration)** is available on Core, Plus, Advanced, Business, Commerce Basic, and Commerce Advanced plans.
> - **Orders API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.
> - **Inventory API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.
> - **Transactions API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.

Your unique API key is a randomized string of characters which permits authenticated access to your Squarespace account.

title: Developer Tools APIs at Squarespace
snippet:
Some of these Developer Tools are available for use by all developers, and some are invite-only. Use of our Developer Tools and participation in any Squarespace developer programs are subject to the [Squarespace Developer Terms](http://squarespace.com/developer-terms).

- If you’re a developer building with our APIs or MCP server to do things like add domain search to your product, create a product integration for your users who also use Squarespace, or otherwise taking part in a Squarespace developer program, our[ Developer Terms of Use](https://www.squarespace.com/developer-terms) cover your use case.
